notes.title: Alice's World Development Update - August 2025
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for your attention! Two months have passed, and summer is coming to a close.[/p][p][i]Alice's World[/i] is now in its final development stage. Here’s a look at what we’ve been working on:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Character Voice Acting[/b] [/h3][p]After a long and painful consideration (mostly due to budget and development time), we've made a big decision—we are adding character voice acting to [i]Alice's World[/i]! You'll soon be able to hear Alice’s voice! We will officially announce more details about the voice cast soon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/c3427e649ebfb0c5d503ae603853e6e6efb233c3.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Multiple Endings[/b] [/h3][p]The game will feature three different endings that change based on your choices. You can be honest, or you can deceive. You can protect her, or you can let her go. No matter what you choose, she will always believe in you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/415b73553a44e0dd62d9fbb9283c53317dcc7b23.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Illustrations and Visual Optimizations[/b][/h3][p]We've added new dynamic effects and drawn new event illustrations. The tower that can grant wishes, the empty mansion… As the story progresses, the secrets of the world will gradually be revealed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/fb5dcfa30b9ab6eaa9e3ecf9d0548644abdd4307.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Attending Busan Indie Connect[/b] [/h3][p]“We want more people to meet Alice!” [/p][p]We participated in the 2025 Busan Indie Connect festival and had the chance to interact with many players from Korea face-to-face. Thank you to everyone who visited and provided feedback. We hope Korean players will love the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/09e6cc8efb9a8b879b56a8da551fdec7c966f791.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The game is scheduled for release in 2025. A single playthrough will take approximately 2-4 hours, depending on an individual's puzzle-solving and reading speed. [/p][p]Please continue to support us as we work to complete this game! The game demo is currently available, and we welcome your feedback—it will be a great help to us![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3259820/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Development Update for Alice’s World: A Look at What’s Next
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has supported Alice’s World! Since releasing the demo, we’ve received so much feedback and encouragement from the community. Today, we’d like to share some updates on the game’s development progress!

[h2] Development Highlights [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Text Refinement[/b]
We’ve polished the in-game text to eliminate logical inconsistencies in player-driven choices.
[*] [b]ALice System Upgrade[/b]
The ALice system module has been enhanced for smoother and more natural communication.
[*] [b]Controller Prompt Display[/b]
The system now displays control prompts that match the specific controller players are using.
[*] [b]More Object Interactions[/b]
Expanded interactions between equipped objects and the environment, unlocking even more surprising outcomes.
[*][b] Voice Acting[/b]
We’ve added voiceovers to bring the game’s characters to life.
[/list]

The full game will feature four chapters and multiple endings. The current demo covers the first chapter, and we’re aiming for a full release in Q2 2025 (fingers crossed!).

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to join our community on QQ or Discord, or leave us a comment.
